questions.question: What did the LORD say He would send on Egypt if its king, Pharaoh, refused to let God's people go?
When frogs covered Egypt, what did its king, Pharaoh, ask Moses and Aaron, God's messengers, to do?

answers.text: Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away
Strike the river with the staff again
Order the frogs out of the palace

questions.question: After Aaron made frogs cover Egypt, the king's magicians could not copy it with their magic arts. True or false?
After Egypt's magicians failed to copy the gnats Aaron made, what did the magicians tell Pharaoh?

answers.text: This is the finger of God
This is the staff of Aaron
This is the hand of Moses
